goal: Define a unified architectural error-handling strategy for the codebase
Avoid repeated ad-hoc debates across validation and subsystem PRs over handling errors
agreement: Concept approval for defining an error-handling strategy (sedited, josibake, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: contradicts established practices and adds technical debt (ajtowns)
Objection: process aborts risk wallet database corruption and loss of funds (furszy)
Objection: global aborts break non-consensus resilience patterns in P2P and RPC (mzumsande)
Objection: exceptions introduce unpredictable control flow and deadlock hazards (l0rinc, maflcko)

categories.name: docs
why: P2 because establishing a clear strategy removes recurring debates across subsystems
Unblocks architectural decisions for open pull requests across the project
